identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Govern configuration-generation handoff across CSM, Guardian, and kernel

values.task_boundary: Close only the configuration-generation authority and crash-recovery gap remaining after #589 and #678.
deliverables: Focused failpoint and prior-generation restoration proof
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A committed receipt binds canonical content hash, schema version, redacted secret references, and compatible Runtime binary generation.
AC-2: One atomic active reference identifies the committed receipt and partial candidates never become authoritative.
AC-3: CSM, Guardian, kernel, status, and readiness expose and validate the same configuration generation and digest.
AC-4: Secret values never enter receipts, status, logs, or retained evidence.
AC-5: Invalid, missing, incompatible, rolled-back, cross-generation, or digest-mismatched receipts fail before service mutation.
AC-6: Isolated tests prove recovery before activation, after pointer replacement, after candidate readiness, and before commit cleanup.
AC-7: Candidate failure restores the prior committed generation and its receipt/reference authority.
AC-8: Focused tests, diff hygiene, and independent exact-head review pass before publication.
non_goals: Provider model agent or Observatory changes
